When a charity selects a paid plan and registers, the Supabase user and org are created immediately BEFORE Stripe payment is completed. If the user abandons the Stripe checkout (or automation fails at that step), the account is marked Active in the system with no subscription and no plan. The _authenticated route guard only checks if the user exists and is not suspended — it does NOT check for an active subscription — so the user can log in and access the full app without ever paying.
